annotation.interpretation_a: The R2 value must allow for retransmissions for a minimum of 180 seconds.
annotation.interpretation_b: The R2 value must allow for retransmissions up to, but not necessarily including, 180 seconds. A value allowing 179.999 seconds would technically satisfy 'at least 3 minutes'.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'at least 3 minutes' is open to interpretation. Does it mean exactly 3 minutes (180 seconds), or any value greater than or equal to 3 minutes? The lack of precision creates ambiguity in the required R2 value.
